question: restaurants inside Belém district
sql: SELECT lp.names.primary AS name, lp.geometry FROM lisbon_places lp WHERE lp.basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Within(lp.geometry, (SELECT lb.geometry FROM lisbon_buildings lb WHERE lb.names.primary = 'Belém'))

question: buildings intersecting the Tagus river polygon
sql: SELECT lb.id, lb.subtype, lb.geometry FROM lisbon_buildings lb WHERE ST_Intersects(lb.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE names.primary LIKE '%Tejo%' OR names.primary LIKE '%Tagus%'))

question: historic sites within 500m of Praça do Comércio
sql: SELECT lp.names.primary AS name, lp.taxonomy.primary AS category FROM lisbon_places lp WHERE lp.taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site' AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(lp.geometry::POINT, (SELECT geometry::POINT FROM lisbon_places WHERE names.primary = 'Praça do Comércio'), 500)

question: parks touching forested areas
sql: SELECT p1.names.primary AS park_name FROM lisbon_places p1 JOIN lisbon_places p2 ON ST_Touches(p1.geometry, p2.geometry) WHERE p1.taxonomy.primary = 'park' AND p2.taxonomy.primary = 'natural_feature' AND p2.names.primary ILIKE '%forest%'

question: show all cafes contained in Parque das Nações
sql: SELECT lp.names.primary AS cafe_name, lp.geometry FROM lisbon_places lp WHERE lp.basic_category = 'cafe' AND ST_Within(lp.geometry, (SELECT lb.geometry FROM lisbon_buildings lb WHERE lb.names.primary = 'Parque das Nações'))

question: find museums that are not inside any building footprint
sql: SELECT lp.names.primary AS museum_name, lp.geometry FROM lisbon_places lp WHERE lp.taxonomy.primary = 'museum' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lisbon_buildings lb WHERE ST_Contains(lb.geometry, lp.geometry))
